{{- /*
cleanAndQuoteFreeTextInput sanitizes user input for safe use in XML/HTML contexts.

This function performs the following steps:
1. Converts whitespace characters (\n, \r, \t) to spaces
2. Escapes XML/HTML special characters (&, <, >, ", ') and converts µ to &#181;
3. Removes all characters except allowed ones (see character set below)
4. Collapses multiple consecutive spaces into a single space
5. Trims leading and trailing whitespace

Allowed characters:
- Space and all printable ASCII: ! " # $ % & ' ( ) * + , - . / 0-9 : ; < = > ? @
- A-Z, a-z, [ \ ] ^ _ ` { | } ~
- Extended Latin characters: € ¡ ¢ £ ¤ ¥ § ¨ ¯ ´ ¶ · ¿
- À-Ý, ß, à-ý, þ (Western European accented characters)

This is based on the investigation what TC can handle. For more info, see:
https://karolinska.atlassian.net/browse/KIP-57?focusedCommentId=47245

Usage:
  {{ template "cleanAndQuoteFreeTextInput" (index .Data "mykey") }}
  {{ include "cleanAndQuoteFreeTextInput" .someField | quote }}
*/ -}}
{{- define "cleanAndQuoteFreeTextInput" -}}
  {{- $input := . -}}

  {{- /* Step 1: Replace newlines, carriage returns, and tabs with spaces */ -}}
  {{- $step1 := $input | replace "\n" " " | replace "\r" " " | replace "\t" " " -}}

  {{- /* Step 2: Escape XML/HTML special characters, then convert µ to numeric entity */ -}}
  {{- /* Note: µ must be replaced AFTER & to avoid double-escaping (&#181; not &amp;#181;) */ -}}
  {{- $step2 := $step1 | replace "&" "&amp;" | replace "<" "&lt;" | replace ">" "&gt;" | replace "\"" "&quot;" | replace "'" "&apos;" | replace "µ" "&#181;" -}}

  {{- /* Step 3: Remove all characters not in the allowed character set */ -}}
  {{- /* The pattern [^ -~...] means: remove anything NOT in this set */ -}}
  {{- /* " -~" represents ASCII printable characters (space=0x20 through tilde=0x7E) */ -}}
  {{- $step3 := regexReplaceAll "[^ -~€¡¢£¤¥§¨¯´¶·¿ÀÁÂÃÄÅÆÇÈÉÊËÌÍÎÏÐÑÒÓÔÕÖ×ØÙÚÛÜÝßàáâãäåæçèéêëìíîïðñòóôõö÷øùúûüýþ]" $step2 "" -}}

  {{- /* Step 4: Collapse multiple consecutive spaces into a single space */ -}}
  {{- $step4 := regexReplaceAll " +" $step3 " " -}}

  {{- /* Step 5: Trim leading and trailing whitespace and quote everything */ -}}
  {{- $step4 | trim | quote -}}
{{- end -}}
